hint.text: Commas are used to separate question tags from the rest of the sentence. There should be a comma before the question tag.

atoms.a: We have seen this film already haven’t we?
It is Monday today, isn’t it?
You’re turning 20 this year, aren’t you?
We turned the lights off didn’t we?
Your brother is a nurse, isn’t he?
I should say sorry shouldn’t I?
